newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK restaurant receipts up 8.8 pct in 1st qtr 1997.
newsitem.headline: HK restaurant receipts up 8.8 pct in 1st qtr 1997.

text.p: Hong Kong's restaurant receipts increased 8.8 percent to HK$14.84 billion in the first quarter of 1997 from the same period last year, provisional Census and Statistics Department data showed on Thursday.
Receipts of bars increased by 10.3 percent in value and those of Chinese restaurants rose by 10.9 percent.
Fast food outlets' receipts increased by 11.1 percent in value and those of non-Chinese restaurants grew by 2.0 percent.
In the fourth quarter of 1996, restaurant receipts increased nine percent year-on-year to HK$14.6 billion.
